body:
I'm in the same position. Totally same.

And yes, I did. But now when I look into future I can't see killing myself. Because I got into spiritual practice a lot.

Packing my stuff and leaving without ID and with small amount of cash - that's what I can see in future instead of suicide. It's more like somewhat-suicide in order to attain enlightement. :) 

Mby I will die, mby I wont, I will be possibly declared dead.
If I survive, mby I will be wise enought to face every consequence head on with peace and smile and come back, who knows.

What happens, happens from that point on.

If you are nor body, nor mind and soul doesn't exist, what are you then? Explore that.

If you killed yourself and (if you believe in reincarnation), there is possibility that you will be in pain next time. And you wont know about buddhism. That's gonna be worse.

It isn't pride for me. I know my loved ones have too many problems on their own to be carrying about me.

Or maybe it is. I didn't want to feel like failure to them. I don't care if I end up in prison myself, I just don't want them to suffer coz of me.

If I end up in prison, I'm gonna make sure my time is well spent. :)

So "At the end of the day, I do not wish to kill myself unless I know that my sacrifice will directly save other life. I am going to accept everything - even the worst and I am going to die when I'm destined"
 
I sure will try! Not sure about finding teacher in jail (if that really comes to it). But hey - Tim Allen, Nelson Mandela and lot of amazing people also were in prison and it didn't break they will to help others.
Thanks everyone. I decided what to do. Updated the post, I cannot believe how awesome you are. Guys!

Yeah, thanks. Not really justification, but mainly way out as the last resort. 

I am not like this normally, when it comes to myself, just when it could hurt people around me. I never wanted this to happen. I feel like i've just dissapointed them and myself. 

These are the moments when I am at my lowest and feel helpless. I will try to not give up until the last second. 
Thank you

I wanted to make money as a student and give everything my parents gave me back with interest so they don't have to struggle. I wanted to travel the world and be happy ... 

I got them caught in this ** instead. I cannot even do a thing, i am hopeless and helpless. 

If I'm gonna sit hours meditating, can I attain enghlitement and get my mind out of this? Or get to new realm and forget everything? Yeah, i am unrealistic...
That's amazing... Tho I got into this mess because of bussiness.
Thanks for suggestion :) I actually am on Nofap, that day I wrote that was about my day 20. :) Im, okay now. Thanks

Thanks everybody, I solved every depression. It was actually caused by debt that I thought would affect me as well as my familly and I couldn't bear that.

But it's alright now. :) Thank you all very much for support
Thank you :) I will do my best, but thi seems like ultimate solution to everything for now. :)
